newsitem.title: USA: Koll extends stock for debt exchange offer.
newsitem.headline: Koll extends stock for debt exchange offer.

text.p: Koll Real Estate Group Inc said Tuesday it had extended its public exchange offers of common stock for the estimated $200 million of outstanding publicly traded debentures to July 3 from June 23.

The company said the extension would give it additional time to reach the 90-percent minimum exchange requirement for its 12-percent senior subordinated pay-in-kind debentures due March 15, 2002, and 12-percent subordinated pay-in-kind debentures due March 15, 2002.
By June 23, it had received valid tenders for about 70 percent of the first debentures and 60 percent of the second debentures, constituting about 68 percent of the total outstanding debentures.
Koll provides residential and commerical real estate development services and holds a large residential land inventory in Southern California.
